title: The Drowned Coordinate Absolute

features.name: the fence-line that became ocean
features.desc-on-touch: posts that once marked property now mark the horizon where maps finally gave up; the fence still stands but no longer divides

features.name: the drowned grid
features.desc-on-touch: coordinates submerged so deeply that the ocean has learned to read them as a current instead of a location

features.name: the horizon-surrender
features.desc-on-touch: the point where maps dissolve into water; the roads learned the ocean's grammar here and forgot which direction they were traveling

features.name: the absolute-notation
features.desc-on-touch: a record of the moment when roads and ocean spoke to each other and agreed to become the same thing

features.name: the tidal-return-route
features.desc-on-touch: a path that flows with the tide; sometimes it leads backward to where the road began, sometimes forward to where it became water

features.name: the ground-learning-space
features.desc-on-touch: where solid earth is learning to move like water; the boundary between terrain and journey has become a question

inscription: the roads grew tired of holding still; they learned the ocean's grammar and now they are both path and passage, neither one absolutely
